extracted.name: Happy Shrimp
extracted.description: This spicy shrimp dish features a luscious sauce of tomatoes, cream, white wine, basil, and cayenne pepper. Serve with crusty bread or over hot pasta.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound peeled and deveined medium shrimp
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Stir in shrimp, green onions, and garlic; cook and stir until shrimp are pink on the outside and no longer translucent in the center, about 5 minutes. Transfer shrimp mixture to a plate and set aside.
Add tomatoes, cream, wine, basil, and cayenne pepper to the same skillet. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until sauce coats the back of a spoon, about 10 minutes.
Add shrimp mixture to sauce in the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until heated through.
